nom: VANICREAM Cleansing Bar for Sensitive Skin

segments.sensitive: Most reviewers describing sensitive, allergy-prone, or eczema/rosacea-affected skin report the bar cleanses without stripping, itching, or triggering reactions, though a few still note dryness or burning.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry or very dry skin generally say the bar cleans without drying further and helps lock in moisture, though a couple describe it as slightly drying, especially on hands.
segments.oily: The one reviewer specifying oily skin reports a clean, non-greasy complexion afterward.
segments.combination: A reviewer with combination, dehydrated, eczema-prone skin reports it eased flare-ups and left skin smooth and hydrated.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their late 50s-60s with mature, thin, or rosacea-prone skin report reduced redness and a soft, clear complexion over time.
segments.normal: One reviewer without self-described sensitive skin reports the bar caused breakouts and did not suit her.

concerns.aging: A 65-year-old and a 58-year-old reviewer, both told to avoid anti-aging actives, report the bar keeps skin soft and complexion clear as part of a simple routine.
concerns.dehydration: Many reviewers say the bar cleans without leaving skin dry or tight, including on dry or eczema-prone skin; a few report notable dryness, particularly on hands or after regular face use.
concerns.redness: Reviewers with rosacea report reduced redness and no burning; one reviewer specifically credits it with calming rosacea-related irritation.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers with eczema, dermatitis, and Sjögren's-related dryness report fewer flares and no stripping or itching; one severe dermatitis case reports the bar as one of the most effective products tried.
concerns.spots: Several reviewers, including parents of teens and adults with body acne, report breakouts clearing within one to a few weeks; one reviewer reports the opposite, developing large boils after facial use.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers describe acne-prone and teen skin clearing up, sometimes allowing them to stop topical acne medication; no negative reports on blemishes besides the one boils case already noted under spots.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer with both oily and dry skin plus psoriasis reports the bar balanced both without irritating her skin further.

aspects.libelle: Bar melts or wears down quickly

extraits.texte: I used this on my face and broke out big time. I'm not sure why this happened but I got four big boils on my face. I wouldn't purchase Thai and I don't have sensitive skin. I've used other vanicream items I think this one just didn't mix well for me.

I just started using the cleansing bar. During the day I use the facial moisturizer with hyaluronic acid and ceramides, the Vanicream cream ( over the moisturizer) and the facial spf 30 on top. I need all 3 moisturizers for my very dry skin. I think the cleansing bar does a very good job at removing the products at night ( esp the sunscreen). My go-to facial hydrating cleanser was good but never seemed to completely remove the sunscreen. I do think the cleansing bar is slightly drying but it prepares my skin well for the application of the moisturizers at the same time. I've only been using it for a week. I have very sensitive, fair, thin skin and mild rosacea (just redness). The cleansing bar seems to minimize the redness though it will likely not eliminate it. After cleansing at night I rub a good amount of the Vanicream cream on my face and follow with a thin layer of Vaseline. I've been using only Vanicream on my face for about 9 months. I'm 65. A few people have told me recently that I have beautiful skin! So I'm not switching to anything else! I'm staying with Vanicream!!

I need to start by saying that I suffer from very dry skin,very oily skin and also psoriasis on my face. I have the hardest time trying to find products that are able to help with all of these issues. This Vanicream bar was great for me. It took care of the oily skin as well as dry skin without irritating my delicate skin even more. It didn't leave me needing anything more in my morning routine. It didnt leave any residue or strip my natural skin whatsoever. The only complaint I have is I didnt care for the scent. It is not scented but it had an unpleasant light smell to me personally. I tend to go for something with a light clean scent, but that is only my person opinion and does not reflect the performance of the product. I will definitely purchase this again.

extraits.titre: Best on the Market for Severe Dermatitis
extraits.texte: I suffer from severe dermatitis/eczema and seborrheic dermatitis/dandruff. And more recently, an unexplained rising body temperature which flares up the eczema. It gets really bad in the summer and winter months. I get it mostly around my inner elbows, with a bad red rash appearing there that will peel and bleed in summer at its worst, and in the last few years it has spread to my chest and abdomen, back and legs, and my neck while sometimes my lower face. The only thing that will bring it down and work is Prednisone corticosteroid pills that reduce the inflammation, and then Triamcinolone Acetonide or similar corticosteroid topical creams or ointments that will take the rashes away. When I was a baby they found an allergy to Codeine, as well as bar soaps on me. So I had been using Aveeno body wash ever since, as colloidal oatmeal is supposed to be an eczema healer. But I was still getting flare-ups. I was getting it around my hands and wrists until I switched to a hypoallergenic free & clear hand-wash soap.Then my newly-appointed Dermatologist recommended Vanicream and gave me tiny samples of the cleansing bar, the Free & Clear shampoo with conditioner set, and a tiny tube of moisturizing skin cream. These products worked the best out of everything that I have tried before, which included but were not limited to: Neutrogena T/Gel; Head & Shoulders; Selsun Blue; Aveeno body wash & eczema creams; Hydrocortisone creams; Doctor-prescribed Triamcinolone Acetonide 0.1% Cream & Oin

I've tried everything for my insanely sensitive, dry and acne prone skin. It's super super gentle but still gets off all makeup and sunscreen off from my day. It never irritates my skin either and I've been using it for nearly two years up to twice a day (still use moisturizer though!!) It's drastically helped with my skins quality and I'm really grateful. I've also started using it for my body.

extraits.titre: Best soap I've used for dry face w rosacea
extraits.texte: I've used this for about 4 years on face. It's amazing for dry skin with red bumps called rosacea. Finally my face doesn't burn with this amazing bar. I bought it while in Rochester, MN and now I see what people are talking about. Great bar to clean my face and intimate area.
I have been using Vanicream bars for years. I have a very dry, thin skin (Sjogren's syndrome) Only product I can use without drying my skin or itching.
